name: Residential Lot
description: Lots intended for single-family homes, townhouses, or residential structures.

name: Subdivision Lot
description: Planned residential lot within a gated community or subdivision.

name: Agricultural / Farm Land
description: Farmland suitable for crops, rice fields, coconut groves, or orchards.

name: Poultry & Livestock Farm
description: Zoned agricultural land designated for animal husbandry, poultry, or piggery.

name: Commercial Lot
description: High-visibility property along main avenues for retail, offices, or mixed-use buildings.

name: Industrial Park / Warehouse Lot
description: Land zoned for manufacturing, distribution centers, processing plants, or warehouses.

name: Beachfront & Coastal Land
description: Oceanfront, seaside, or coastal land suitable for private estates or resort developments.

name: Eco-Tourism & Mountain Property
description: Elevated, scenic, or hilly land ideal for glamping, eco-resorts, or vacation cabins.

name: Raw Uncut Land
description: Undeveloped vast acreage suitable for land banking, future masterplans, or subdivisions.

name: Island Property
description: Whole private island or island parcel.
